articles.title: MHA bans new solar, wind projects within 1 km of India’s borders
articles.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) has issued new guidelines restricting the establishment of solar, wind, and hybrid renewable energy projects. These projects are now prohibited within a 1-kilometer radius of India's sensitive borders, specifically the Line of Control (LoC) and Line of Actual Control (LAC). This measure is likely aimed at bolstering national security and ensuring strategic control in critical border regions.

articles.title: DRDO expeditiously finalise clear, measurable key performance indicators: Parl panel on defence
articles.summary: A parliamentary panel has urged the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) to expeditiously finalise and notify clear, measurable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). These KPIs should cover cost efficiency and technological maturity, aiming to enhance accountability and streamline defence research. This move is crucial for optimising defence expenditure and ensuring timely delivery of cutting-edge indigenous technologies for India's armed forces.
